info.title: ACH Platform API
info.description: Compliance-first ACH origination and receipt: Nacha rules catalog, FedACH windows and Fed holiday calendar, sanctions/fraud/AML screening, double-entry ledger, returns, NOCs, reconciliation and ITSM monitoring. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`.

post.description: Which FedACH window an entry would go in and when it would settle, given cut-offs, weekends and holidays.

schema.title: Response List Counterparties V1 Counterparties Get

put.description: Change bank details. Triggers re-validation and the 10-day 'changed account' fraud signal.

post.summary: Create an ACH credit or debit
post.description: Validates against the Nacha rules catalog, plans the FedACH window and settlement date, screens sanctions/fraud/AML, then warehouses or holds the entry. Requires Idempotency-Key.

schema.title: Response List Payments V1 Payments Get

post.description: Nacha-permissible reversal (duplicate, wrong receiver, wrong amount, wrong date) within 5 banking days.
Operator: release or reject a held payment. Closes its open alerts.
Ingest a file received from FedACH: forward entries (RDFI), returns and NOCs (ODFI).
Validate a Nacha file without processing it.
Originator file channel: submit a Nacha file; each entry becomes a payment through the same controls as the API.

Submit a pain.001 (customer credit transfer initiation). Body: raw XML (application/xml) or JSON {"content": "<xml>"}. Each transaction becomes an ACH credit through the standard controls; a pain.002 status report is produced immediately.
Submit a pain.008 (customer direct debit initiation). Each transaction becomes an ACH debit; a mandate (MndtId and DtOfSgntr) is required as authorization evidence.

get.description: Current payment status report for a received pain.001/pain.008 (reflects settlement and returns).
Debit/credit notification for a booking day: settled entries and returns (with ISO and Nacha reason codes); NOCs in AddtlNtfctnInf.
End-of-day statement of the originator's settlement account (opening/closing balance and entries).

post.description: Release or return a held inbound entry (credit monitoring / sanctions).
Customer dispute: re-credit and return R05/R07/R10/R11 (consumer, WSUD) or R29 (business).
Originate a Notification of Change to the ODFI.
Run the operations cycle now: release due windows, settle, monitor, deliver webhooks.
Simulate the RDFI returning one of our transmitted payments.
Simulate the RDFI sending a Notification of Change.
Simulate FedACH delivering forward entries to our customers (RDFI flow).
